_note: Model files for the video check (docs/VIDEO_DEEPFAKE.md). They live in models/video/ and are never committed (*.onnx is git-ignored). `python scripts/video_models.py` downloads what has a URL and verifies every sha256; a file whose hash does not match is refused.

blend_b0.onnx.build: python -m research.video.sbi_prep && python -m research.video.train_sbi  (CPU, about 2 h)
